calls.title: Marketing <> Sales Alignment
calls.summary: The call focused on aligning marketing and sales for GrowthBook, discussing targeting segments (enterprise, mid-market, fast-growing AI startups) and pain points like resource strain, competition with PostHog, and under-resourced follow-ups. Key participants were Lyndsie Berens (marketing), Ashley Stirrup (product/marketing), Ryan McGurk (sales), and Scott Bailey (product/roadmap). Next steps include finalizing a startup landing page, prioritizing enterprise and AI segments, hiring additional BDRs, assigning hot leads to AEs, and exploring competitive win

calls.title: Marketing <> Sales Alignment
calls.summary: In this meeting, the team prioritized sales efforts on enterprise and mid-market segments, with Lyndsie emphasizing the need for additional staff to support enterprise sales. They are carefully testing AI startups and fast-growing companies through a lightweight approach. Ryan suggested hiring an Account Executive to balance the pipeline, starting by mid to late August. The team discussed developing minimal marketing outreach materials for the startup segment and highlighted improvements in lead qualification processes to enhance sales efficiency. They also emphasized the importance of product differentiation against competitors like Posthog, focusing on feature flagging strength and integration with AI tools. Marketing resources are stretched thin, necessitating focused support for AI outreach and efficient event lead follow-up.
calls.keywords: AI startups, Enterprise sales, ABM program, Marketing channels, Pipeline coverage, Competitive positioning
